description: The messages that carry calls made in text back to the model (agent#4), in the order of one run: the runtime's validate answered {"status":"valid"}, its bounded answer as JSON framed as one data block with the run's marker (agent#12; framing/framed-result.json), here a fixed one, as a run draws its own; an answer that made two calls, so none was made; and a call of write_file, a tool the run was not offered, refused through the gate: a failure the harness wrote, shown as it is. Written by hand from the schema; engines/vercel/capabilities.test.ts holds a run's requests to each.
